description: Dreamwalker Wristguards Level 60 Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Wristguards if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Wristguards, 6 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 2 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Wristguards - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 6 - Arcane Crystal - Cured Rugged Hide x 2
name: Dreamwalker Wristguards
